budget_note: The reference budget is sized from the worst case measured at calibration: a grid built to defeat row-major backtracking needed 69.2 million nodes and 18 seconds. Generated puzzles need a few thousand. Exceeding a budget is a rejection, never a pass.
note: Frozen by FOUNDATION.md. Bands may never be re-tuned to change how the existing corpus classifies. The solver asserts at load that its ladder still matches technique_tiers exactly, so editing a technique's tier in code breaks the build rather than silently reclassifying the corpus.
